description: Source code for a wizard interface in Odoo (OpenERP) handling employee sign-in and sign-out processes, including form definitions, data retrieval, and action methods.

classes.name: wiz_si_so
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing sign-in and sign-out states and transitions.

methods.name: _get_empid
methods.description: Retrieves employee info based on current user ID.

methods.name: _get_empid2
methods.description: Retrieves employee info and latest attendance action for sign-in/out process.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Creates or updates timesheet entries based on sign-in/out data.

methods.name: _sign_out_result_end
methods.description: Handles employee sign-out and updates timesheet.

methods.name: _sign_out_result
methods.description: Handles employee sign change and updates timesheet.

methods.name: _state_check
methods.description: Determines current attendance state for employee.
